one_line: Rajput chief of Chanderi who defied Babur during the 1528 siege.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, lean and wiry with a battle-hardened build.
appearance.face: Angular oval face with high cheekbones, straight nose, medium-deep wheatish complexion; sharp dark eyes with a calm, resolute gaze; neatly trimmed moustache and short beard shaped along the jaw; default expression is composed, determined focus with a hint of melancholy.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a low knot at the back of the head, mostly hidden under a wrapped Rajput-style turban: a layered cotton pagri in muted maroon with a narrow mustard band near the edge and a small upright feather tucked at the left side.
appearance.costume: Over a long-sleeved quilted cotton gambeson (angarkha-style coat) in dusty off-white with subtle vertical stitching, he wears a well-fitted mail shirt that reaches mid-thigh and half-sleeves at the upper arm; over this, a sleeveless cotton-and-leather surcoat in deep indigo with a simple narrow maroon border and a small sun motif in dull gold over the left chest; a plain maroon cloth sash wraps tightly around his waist, securing a brown leather belt with a simple iron buckle; below, he wears loose ghaghra-style trousers in muted mustard cotton tucked into sturdy dark brown leather boots that rise just below the knee; his forearms are protected with plain steel bracers padded inside with cloth, and he wears minimal jewellery: a single small iron kada on his right wrist and modest round silver stud earrings; textiles are matte cotton and quilted padding, with the mail rendered as small, tightly linked rings and leather appearing worn but well cared for.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Rajput talwar with a steel blade, a simple brass hilt with disc pommel, and a plain brown leather scabbard; the sword is worn at his left hip, the scabbard tied to his maroon waist sash with a visible cord.

ref_desc: Medini Rai is a late-30s Rajput chief with a wheatish angular face, short beard, maroon-and-mustard turban, off-white quilted gambeson under mail, deep indigo sleeveless surcoat, mustard trousers, brown boots, maroon sash and belt, carrying a curved talwar at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Medini Rai of Chanderi: a late-30s, lean Rajput chief with an angular wheatish face, sharp dark eyes, neat moustache and short beard, wearing a layered maroon cotton turban with a narrow mustard edge band and a small feather on the left, thick black hair tied in a low knot beneath. Show him in a long-sleeved off-white quilted cotton gambeson with visible vertical stitching, over which sits a mid-thigh mail shirt with short half-sleeves; add a sleeveless deep indigo surcoat over the mail, with a narrow maroon border and a small dull-gold sun motif over the left chest. Wrap a maroon cloth sash around his waist, over which a brown leather belt with a simple iron buckle is fastened; from this belt hangs his signature slightly curved talwar in a plain brown leather scabbard on his left hip, secured with a visible cord to the sash. Give him loose mustard cotton trousers tucked neatly into sturdy dark brown leather boots that rise just below the knee, simple plain steel forearm bracers padded beneath, a single iron kada bracelet on his right wrist, and small round silver stud earrings. Use a palette dominated by deep indigo, maroon, mustard, off-white and dark brown, and present him from multiple angles with clear views of face, turban, armour layers, sash, belt and sword placement in a clean, historically grounded yet dynamic shonen-anime style.
